newsitem.title: CANADA: Pinnacle joins Alliance Pipeline partners.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle joins Alliance Pipeline partners.

text.p: Alliance Pipeline, which on Wednesday won preliminary approval in the United States to build the C$3.6 million gas pipeline, said on Thursday that Canadian oil and gas producer Pinnacle Resources Ltd took an equity position in the proposed project.

Pinnacle joins 18 other companies, including Alberta Energy Co Ltd, Chauvco Resources Ltd, Gulf Canada Resources Ltd and IPL Energy Inc, in developing the pipeline, which would ship 1.3 billion cubic feet of gas a day to Chicago from northeastern British Columbia.

The project, which under current plans would be completed in 1999, got a big boost Wednesday when the United States Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) approved a preliminary determination on non-environmental issues.

Alliance said the approval meant that, subject to completion of an environmental review, the FERC believed Alliance was in the public interest and should be built. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
